title: asplenium ruta-muraria var. leptophyllum
intro: Asplenium ruta-muraria var. leptophyllum, commonly known as the wall rue fern or wall fern, is a type of flowering plant in the fern family (Aspleniaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe and calm the skin, reduce inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of A. ruta-muraria var. leptophyllum include various flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
